messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
when i wake up middle of the night, my eyes was open.

output.original_text: when i wake up middle of the night, my eyes was open.
output.joy: when I wake up in the middle of the night, my eyes are wide open with excitement!
output.sadness: when I wake up in the middle of the night, my eyes open but I feel so alone.
output.fear: when I wake up in the middle of the night, my eyes snap open and a chill runs down my spine.
output.anger: when I wake up in the middle of the night, my eyes open and I can't believe I'm awake again!
output.surprise: when I wake up in the middle of the night, my eyes open wide in shock!
output.disgust: when I wake up in the middle of the night, my eyes open, and all I feel is discomfort.
